Hi,

All the hard work the volunteers at Citizens for Prosperity have been doing is starting to pay off. Not only have we established outposts to house and protect people looking for a peaceful life, but our goal of making each outpost prosperous in their own right is coming to fruition.

There’s a handful of outposts that have produced some valuable commodities that are ready for pick up and delivery to [Destination]. Any chance you could swing by the outposts to grab the goods?

Here’s where everything needs to be picked up from: 

Pick up package #[Item1] at [Location].
Pick up package #[Item4] at [Location].
Pick up package #[Item5] at [Location1].
Pick up package #[Item2] at [Location1].
Pick up package #[Item3] at [Location2].

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 

As always, thanks for your help making this system a little brighter.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
